title: Troublemaker
lyrics:
[00:00.82]You're a troublemaker, You're a troublemaker
[00:07.54]You ain't nothing but a troublemaker, girl
[00:10.48]You had me hooked again from the minute you sat down
[00:14.81]The way you bite your lip got my head spinnin' around

[00:32.63]I know you're no good but you're stuck in my brain
